gloss: to echo; to resound; to ring out

definitions.gloss: to echo; to resound; to ring out across an area
definitions.explanation: A sound that carries and spreads throughout a wide area. The {渡|わた}る component adds the sense of the sound traveling across a space.

examples.japanese: {鐘|かね}の{音|おと}が{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}った。
examples.english: The sound of the bell rang out.

examples.japanese: {拍手|はくしゅ}が{会場|かいじょう}に{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}った。
{静|しず}かな{山|やま}の{中|なか}に{鳥|とり}の{鳴|な}き{声|ごえ}が{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}っていた。
examples.english: Birdsong echoed through the quiet mountains.

notes:
USAGE:
{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}る is a compound verb that emphasizes a sound spreading across a wide space. It is often used in literary or descriptive writing to create vivid auditory imagery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歓声|かんせい}が{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}る (cheers ring out)
- {銃声|じゅうせい}が{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}る (gunshots echo)
- {雷鳴|らいめい}が{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}る (thunder reverberates)
- {拍手|はくしゅ}が{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}る (applause echoes)

WORD FORMATION:
Compound of {響|ひび}く (to echo, to resound) + {渡|わた}る (to cross over). The ～{渡|わた}る pattern indicates an action that extends across an entire area, as in {見渡|みわた}す (to look out over) or {行|い}き{渡|わた}る (to spread throughout).
